image_description: A dark-furred guenon monkey sitting on a textured ledge near water. The monkey has a slender body, long limbs, and a visible tail extending behind it. The face is bare with forward-facing eyes and a narrow nose, surrounded by a ruff of longer hair. The background is blurred, suggesting an outdoor enclosure.

Eyes are forward-facing; irises appear dark brown/black, consistent with the species.
The nose structure is narrow and prominent, typical of guenons.
Ears are small and partially obscured by fur but visible and proportionate.
